name: BSW B2B Suite for WooCommerce
author: Prashant Dave

sections.description:
BSW B2B Suite for WooCommerce helps you create a professional wholesale registration and pricing system for your WooCommerce store.

Customers can register using a dedicated wholesale registration form. Store administrators can review each application before granting wholesale access.

The plugin is lightweight, easy to configure, and follows WordPress coding standards.

Features

  • Wholesale customer registration form
  • Manual approval workflow
  • Pending customer role
  • Wholesale customer role
  • Registration page selection
  • Role-based percentage discounts
  • Enable or disable pricing rules
  • Clean and user-friendly admin interface
  • Secure form validation
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • Translation ready
  • Built using WordPress Coding Standards
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to B2B Suite → Settings.
  4. Select your Wholesale Registration page.
  5. Configure pricing rules from B2B Suite → Pricing Rules.
  6. Review customer applications from B2B Suite → Applications.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I approve customers manually?

Yes. Every registration is submitted as an application that must be approved by an administrator.

Can I offer wholesale discounts?

Yes. You can create percentage-based pricing rules for wholesale customers.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes.
